svg.title: Prefix cache hit identity and lifetime contract
svg.desc: A digest yields a candidate. Authorized computation and storage identity, exact tokens and ancestor chain, and current complete safely retained state must all pass. The toy sum modulo sixteen collides for reordered token blocks but exact comparison rejects reuse.
svg.text: A digest match proposes a candidate; it is not a cache hit
Text-only causal KV; exact beginning prefix; protected current ownership
1. Match authorized computation and storage identity
2. Verify exact tokens and the complete ancestor chain
Same current block tokens or same digest alone cannot establish equality
3. Validate complete resident state and retain safely
Generation, sealed rows and ownership promotion survive eviction ordering
Toy collision: [1,2,3,4] and [1,2,4,3] both sum to 10 mod 16.
Exact record comparison rejects the second prefix; no payload attaches.
